notes.title: "一統天下" is about to make its debut on the Steam platfo
notes.notes:
Embark on the most classic strategy gameplay inspired by the Three Kingdoms, cultivating your favorite warlords, leading them into battle, and experiencing the exhilaration of seizing territories in real-time national warfare. Coming soon to the Steam platform, add it to your wishlist now and await the grand opening, where you'll ascend to the glorious rank of a dominator!

[Game Features]
❖ 24/7 National Warfare with Ever-changing Territory Battles ❖
"Prepare soldiers for a thousand days to use them for a moment!" Besides managing territories, immerse yourself in realistic national warfare experiences! Playable on PC, mobile phones, and tablets, ensuring you can join the battle wherever you are!

❖ Cross-Server Competitions: Rise to Fame and Become the Sole Overlord of the Three Kingdoms ❖
Tired of facing the same opponents? The cross-server system allows you to dominate the entire server and become a legendary conqueror! Additionally, cross-server competitions offer extra rewards—sign up now!

❖ Civil and Military Officials, Famous Generals of the Three Kingdoms, All Under Your Command ❖
Utilize the unique skills of various warlords to create ever-changing formations! Choose from a variety of combinations to assemble your mightiest Three Kingdoms army!

❖ Divine Weapons in Hand, Invincible in Battle; Technological Advancements Ensure Victory ❖
Apart from strategic generals, the indispensable weapon technology system determines the outcome of battles! Develop various technologies, combine them with weapon gems, and achieve victory after victory!

❖ Sacrifice Resources, Utilize Zhuge Liang's Astrology, and Set Fire to Enemy Ships in the East Wu ❖
Explore the black market for various resources, engage in rituals for blessings, utilize astrology, and employ the chariot system!

❖ Daily National Missions, Exciting and Stimulating ❖
Different missions await you every day, with each completion earning you additional rewards! Join forces with players from the same nation and strategize for domination!
